summary: Collect receipts, categorize them, and submit a report to finance.

1.step_description: Collect all receipts for the week.

exemplars.action: I will collect all paper and digital receipts from the week and place them in one folder for review.
Review each receipt and assign the most appropriate expense category based on the merchant and purchase details.

3.step_description: Sum amounts and validate against policy.

exemplars.action: I will total all expense amounts, verify the calculations and required documentation, flag duplicates or missing data, and check each expense against applicable policy limits and eligibility rules.

4.step_description: Submit the report to the finance system.

exemplars.action: I will submit the completed weekly expense report to the finance system and confirm the submission was successful.
